company.headline: Why we built Northline
company.narrative:
I kept losing retainer hours in a spreadsheet shared with nobody. The team found out a client was over budget when the invoice went out.

Northline shows the hours left on a retainer the moment someone logs time, and the client portal updates with it.

faqs.question: Is this a one-time payment?
faqs.answer: Yes. You pay once and keep the features in your tier.

faqs.question: What happens at the retainer limit?
faqs.answer: Logging time stops accepting new entries until you archive a retainer.

faqs.question: Can I export my data?
faqs.answer: Yes. A CSV of retainers, time entries, and invoices downloads from settings.

faqs.question: How long is the refund window?
How fast does support reply?
faqs.answer: Email sent to the support address gets a reply within one business day.

faqs.question: Can I move a client off the portal?
faqs.answer: You can revoke a portal link without deleting the retainer.
